record.hypothesis: Replace final-state readout with a causal recency-weighted mean of GRU states, using weights 0.8^(t-j) over real positions j<=t. Apply the same pooling at every supervised training position and at the final real position during inference, excluding padding. This may stabilize interest estimates for the mostly short histories while retaining recent intent. Keep truncation, embeddings, GRU topology, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer fixed; update the predictor writer consistently.
